nodes.question: What are some current trends in sustainable product design and development as discussed in Clark et al. (2009)?
nodes.answer: Some current trends in sustainable product design and development include using eco-friendly materials, reducing waste in production processes, and incorporating renewable energy sources.

nodes.question: Were virtues like simplicity in design and quality products initially associated with sustainability?
nodes.answer: Virtues like simplicity in design and quality products were associated with brands, but not necessarily from a sustainability perspective.
